name: hangikurs

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend

//overrides: These patch vulnerable transitive dependencies of firebase-admin that npm
cannot bump on its own: `npm audit fix` is a no-op here, and
`npm audit fix --force` would downgrade firebase-admin 14 to 10.
brace-expansion ^5.0.9 — GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, DoS via unbounded expansion.
Vulnerable copy arrived via minimatch > glob > rimraf > google-gax.
The 2.x line has no patched release (it ends at 2.1.4), so 5.x is the
only way out.
minimatch ^10.2.6 — required *because of* the line above, not for a CVE.
brace-expansion 5 dropped its default export and exports { expand }
instead. minimatch 9 calls the default export, so pairing 9 with 5
throws 'brace_expansion_1.default is not a function' the moment a glob
contains braces. minimatch 10 uses the named export. Removing this
entry silently breaks brace patterns inside glob — verified, not
theoretical.
uuid ^11.1.1 — GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, missing buffer bounds check in
v3/v5/v6. Arrived via gaxios / teeny-request > @google-cloud/storage.
npm reports these as 'invalid' in `npm ls` because they violate the semver
ranges their parents declare. That is expected for an override. The whole
chain was exercised after applying them (minimatch, glob brace patterns,
rimraf, gaxios, teeny-request, google-gax, @google-cloud/storage and
firebase-admin's initializeApp/getAuth/verifyIdToken surface).
Re-check on every firebase-admin upgrade — once it ships patched ranges of
its own, delete these rather than pinning forever.
